title.zh: Kraken 母公司 Payward 获迪拜 VARA 全面批准并计划在阿联酋推出服务
title.en: Kraken Parent Payward Secures Full Dubai VARA Approval and Plans UAE Launch

current_state.zh: Kraken 已获得 VARA 全面批准，可在阿联酋推出受监管的加密服务，扩大其在该地区的持牌版图。
current_state.en: Kraken has secured full VARA approval to launch regulated crypto services in the UAE, expanding its licensed footprint in the region.

updates.title_zh: 【Kraken 母公司 Payward 获迪拜 VARA 全面批准】
updates.title_en: 【Kraken 母公司 Payward 获迪拜 VARA 全面批准】
updates.what_changed_zh: Kraken母公司Payward获得迪拜虚拟资产监管局全面监管批准，为Kraken在阿联酋推出支持AED存取款的服务扫清道路。
updates.what_changed_en: Kraken parent company Payward received full regulatory approval from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority, clearing the way for Kraken to launch in the UAE with AED deposit and withdrawal support.
updates.current_state_zh: Kraken母公司Payward获得迪拜虚拟资产监管局全面监管批准，为Kraken在阿联酋推出支持AED存取款的服务扫清道路。
updates.current_state_en: Kraken parent company Payward received full regulatory approval from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority, clearing the way for Kraken to launch in the UAE with AED deposit and withdrawal support.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kraken parent company Payward received full regulatory approval from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority, clearing the way for Kraken to launch in the UAE with AED deposit and withdrawal support.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kraken parent company Payward received full regulatory approval from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority, clearing the way for Kraken to launch in the UAE with AED deposit and withdrawal support.

updates.title_zh: Kraken母公司Payward获迪拜VARA全面市场批准，计划进军阿联酋市场
updates.title_en: Kraken母公司Payward获迪拜VARA全面市场批准，计划进军阿联酋市场
updates.what_changed_zh: Payward 获 VARA 全面市场批准，可作为受监管 VASP 运营；计划在阿联酋推出 AED 现货和保证金交易、法币出入金、链上质押、xStocks、Krak 转账及机构 OTC/Kraken Prime 服务，衍生品和收益产品预计 2026 年底至 2027 年推出。
updates.what_changed_en: Payward received full market approval from VARA to operate as a regulated VASP; plans to launch in the UAE with AED spot and margin trading, fiat on/off-ramps, staking, xStocks, Krak transfers, institutional OTC/Kraken Prime, with derivatives and yield products targeted for late 2026–2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Payward 已获迪拜 VARA 全面市场批准，可作为受监管 VASP 运营，并计划在阿联酋推出包含 AED 现货/保证金交易、法币出入金、质押、xStocks、Krak 及机构服务在内的产品，衍生品和收益产品预计后续推出。
updates.current_state_en: Payward has full market approval from Dubai VARA to operate as a regulated VASP and plans to launch UAE services including AED spot/margin trading, fiat ramps, staking, xStocks, Krak, and institutional offerings, with derivatives and yield products expected later.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Payward, Kraken's parent company, received full market approval from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority to operate as a regulated VASP and plans to launch in the UAE with AED-denominated spot and margin trading, fiat on/off-ramps, staking, xStocks, Krak transfers, and institutional OTC/Kraken Prime services, with derivatives and yield products targeted for late 2026-2027.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Payward, Kraken's parent company, received full market approval from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority to operate as a regulated VASP and plans to launch in the UAE with AED-denominated spot and margin trading, fiat on/off-ramps, staking, xStocks, Krak transfers, and institutional OTC/Kraken Prime services, with derivatives and yield products targeted for late 2026-2027.
